title: What It Actually Looks Like to Work Hard and Rest Like You Trust God
caption:
A godly man works like it's everything and rests like it isn't. Both are commands, not just the one you like.

Do the Monday task first, the boring one you keep pushing to Friday. Take the rest you didn't earn before your body forces the stop for you. Stop confusing a full calendar with a full life.

Whatever you do, work at it with your whole heart, as for the Lord and not for the credit.

#faith #discipline #godlymen #christianman #rest #sabbath #manofgod
